projects.title: Blitz Quiz
projects.description:
An education tool for teachers used to send out quizzes to students in real time.
The teachers could save the quizzes with different questions and send them out whenever they would like to. They can create new quizzes and add new questions on the fly before sending the quizzes out to the students.
The students only have access to the quiz once the teacher sends it out to them. And once they are done with the quiz, the teacher gets their response in real time.
The teacher can then see the results charted in graphs for a more visual pleasing representation of the collected data.
In the results, he/she could see which questions are stumbling the students, and which students are having trouble in his/ her class.

projects.title: Walkie Talkie
projects.description:
A chatting app that made use of sockets to have real time non persisting chat rooms based on location.
Users can login using their Facebook or Google account so that when they chat, their names and profile pics will be shown.
